page.overview:
What is Shard of Adonalsium?

The Shards of Adonalsium, or Shards are pieces of the power of Creation itself. There are sixtthumbeen Shards in the cosmere. Three of the Shards are located in the Rosharan System: they are Odium (Rayse), Cultivation, and Honor (Almighty/Tanavast, deceased).
